content:
kyle: Anyone else seeing clients reconnect mid-stream when we hit quota enforcement?
anya: yep saw a spike in reconnects around 17:41 UTC, looks like ~3% of streams.
michael (runtime): Repro steps? SSE or websocket? Which proxy path?
jordan: mostly EventSource (SSE) from the hosted API. Clients report 'error' event then reconnection.
kyle: We have a chunked response that abruptly ends with 200 -> connection close. No trailing done event.
nisha: Are we returning a non-200 before close? quota service might be returning 429 then we close.
michael (runtime): Checked logs: quota check happens async in routing. When limit exceeded mid-stream we inject a short-lived 429 and close socket.
anya: That explains it. But EventSource reconnect semantics mean the browser will reconnect with last-event-id, which may produce duplicate tokens if we don't mark the stream ended.
jordan: Example client console: 
```
EventSource error at 17:41:12
readyState: 2
// then reconnects immediately
```
nisha: Proxy also has an idle timeout at 60s, but these reconnects happen well before that.
kyle: I captured server side snippet: 
```
// simplified
if (quota.exceeded) {
  res.writeHead(429, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
  res.end('quota exceeded');
  closeConnection();
}
```
anya: That `res.end()` without a proper SSE `event: done

` means clients think the stream died unexpectedly.
michael (runtime): Options: 1) send a final SSE event `event: quota
data: {reason}

` then close; 2) switch to a persistent 429-and-keep-alive payload (ugly); 3) force a websocket close with code/reason.
jordan: Also need telemetry: count of mid-stream quota terminations, plus reconnection loop detection (>=5 reconnects within 30s).
nisha: For hosted we must avoid returning bare 429 mid-stream because our proxies (nginx/gw) sometimes convert that into connection reset to the client. Browser then can't see the 429 and just reconnects.
kyle: UX concern: Console currently shows stream as 'connected' based on WS open. When quota kills it, console briefly shows closed then reconnects — user thinks LLM is flakey. We should display 'ended by policy: quota' if we can detect it.
michael (runtime): Proposal: add header `X-Stream-Termination: quota` on the final chunk + send proper SSE `event: termination` then close gracefully. Console will read last-event-id or header.
anya: How will this work with existing EventSource client? EventSource doesn't expose headers on reconnect. But the final event will be visible.
jordan: For websocket fallback, send a JSON message `{"type":"termination","reason":"quota"}` before closing. For SSE send `event: termination
data: {"reason":"quota"}

`.
nisha: We also need to adjust LB idle timeout to 300s for long sessions and ensure `proxy_buffering off` so streaming chunks go to client.
michael (runtime): (reaction) :thumbsup: I can add a feature flag to runtime: when termination is policy-driven, emit termination event and set `X-Stream-Session: <uuid>` header at stream start. That lets console map reconnections to the same session.
kyle: Good. Also record these fields in telemetry: session_id, termination_reason, tokens_generated, last_chunk_ts, reconnect_count.
anya: For rollouts: let's gate on 10% of traffic for 48h, monitor reconnect rate + client error reports.
michael (runtime): I'll open a PR for SSE/WebSocket termination framing + session header. Will add metrics: `stream.termination.policy` and `stream.reconnect.count`.
jordan: One more gotcha — mobile clients sometimes respect EventSource retry but not last-event-id reliably. Suggest adding server-side dedup of prompt completions using `stream.session_id` when possible.
nisha: Ops: update nginx conf on hosted to `proxy_read_timeout 360s; proxy_send_timeout 360s; proxy_buffering off;` and add health check for streaming path.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rolling deploy to canary (10%) at 2025-11-02T02:00:00Z with tag streaming-termination-v1
kyle: Thanks — can someone add a short note in the console UX doc explaining 'ended by policy' state and link to help center?
michael (runtime): On it, PRs incoming: runtime change + nginx template + telemetry. Will post updates here.
anya: I'll watch metrics and recreate the spike test with a simulated quota cut mid-stream.
kyle: Awesome. If no objections I'll merge canary tomorrow. :+1:
